home.title: The Long Math
home.description: Interactive financial calculators, tools, and explanations for long-term personal and small-business financial trade-offs.
home.manifesto1: The Long Math is a growing collection of interactive financial calculators, tools, and explanations designed to make long-term personal and small-business financial trade-offs visible.
home.manifesto2: Most financial decisions are presented as stories. This site focuses on arithmetic. It examines how fees, taxes, compounding, and incentives interact over decades, using transparent assumptions and explicit calculations that can be inspected and verified.
home.manifesto3: No opinions. No hidden assumptions. Just arithmetic.
home.featuredDesc: Quantifies the long-term impact of advisory fees and lost compounding using explicit assumptions and inspectable math.
home.featuredExample: An example of what this looks like in practice.
